gloss: water tanker truck; water supply truck

definitions.gloss: water tanker truck; water supply truck
definitions.explanation: A truck equipped with a large water tank, used to deliver drinking water to areas where the regular supply has been cut off—typically after earthquakes, typhoons, or other disasters.

examples.japanese: {給水車|きゅうすいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The water tanker truck has arrived.

examples.japanese: ⟦{断水|だんすい}→断水：04518_dansui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{給水車|きゅうすいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}んだ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: We called for a water tanker because the water was cut off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{何台|なんだい}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{給水車|きゅうすいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After the earthquake, several water tanker trucks were dispatched to the affected area every day.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{給水|きゅうすい}→給水：15031_kyuusui⟧ (water supply) + ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (vehicle).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {給水車|きゅうすいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: a water tanker arrives
- {給水車|きゅうすいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dispatch water tankers
- {給水車|きゅうすいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up at the water tanker

USAGE:
Most commonly seen in disaster-relief news. After a major earthquake or typhoon damages the water supply, local governments and the Self-Defense Forces dispatch {給水車|きゅうすいしゃ} so residents can fill containers with drinking water.
